info.name: LJVIS — TRAM control card (ADR-002, single entity)
info.description: Functional tests for /v1/control-forms/tram-card/** — the single-entity TRAM control card (forms.tram_control_card). Covers the tram_driver_form.write/read permission boundary, the tram-AAAA-NNNNN number series, the saved -> confirmed -> published lifecycle (publish only from confirmed), the driverNotApplicable path, controlDate validation, and the e-toimik auto-publish path (select_etoimik_candidates / apply_etoimik_decision idempotency). Self-contained.
